spans.s: --a राक्षस Gan2a from निरृति; the followers of Kubera; hence देवराक्षसस्. वा. ६९. १७३.

--one of the four राक्षस clans after नैरृत, moving about during nights: followers of Trayambaka: देवराक्षसस्, heroic and valourous, with their leader वीरूपाक्ष: अलकाधिप was their king;
1: भा. XII. ११. ४८; Br.

. १४१-4, १६३; 8. ६२.
sons of रेवती and पूतना: overlord Skanda: gave trouble to babies.
2: Ib.

(I)--a town of निरृति;
1: भा. X. ८९. ४४.
बलि to be given to निरृति in श्राद्ध.
2: वा. १११. ४०.
